title: Tripotent {0, 1} Mobius Projectors and the 4.71x Square-Free Subspace Compression Booster
description:
Because the classical Mobius function satisfies the algebraic tripotency μ^3 = μ, we construct an exact binary projector resolution of the identity: I = P_+ + P_- + P_0, where P_+, P_-, P_0 ∈ {0, 1} are mutually orthogonal. The null-projector P_0 corresponds to square-full integers containing repeated prime factors (density 1 - 6/π^2 ≈ 39.21%). Because square-full directions carry zero exterior volume (v ∧ v = 0), projecting the full N-dimensional space onto the pure square-free subspace drops 39.2% of redundant dimensions, saves 63.0% of memory, and delivers a 4.45× to 4.71× speedup with zero information loss. We formalize in Lean 4 the tripotent projector split, subspace compression, geometric tail bounds, and multiscale two-Rosetta arch contraction with zero custom axioms.
